title: CueFX hand track (API form)
description: One entry per plate frame 0..frames-1, in order. x, y: palm centre in plate pixels, already smoothed by the tracker. Maps to the cue file's track: frame=f, confidence=conf, uncertain=lost.

confidence.description: detector score; 0 on frames where the hand was not detected (interpolated)

uncertain.description: inside a lost gap: the position is a guess

source.description: backend extra; the UI may ignore it

palm_w.description: backend extra: palm width in plate px (index to little-finger knuckle); for a body point other than the palm (v2.6) its size measure, see CONTRACT.md section 2
